overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on abstractive dialogue summarization using curriculum-based prompt learning with self-training. It evaluates using both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore) and human evaluation (expert ratings on three criteria). No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The main contribution is a novel prompt learning approach for low-resource dialogue summarization.
